name: cascade_delete
description: In the DELETE /api/customers/:c_custkey handler, child orders are explicitly deleted with 'DELETE FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = ?' before the customer is deleted. The GET /api/orders endpoint performs a JOIN between orders and customer to return orders tied to active customers; after a customer deletion, any orders that were deleted alongside that customer are permanently lost and cannot be returned by this or any other read endpoint that depends on order data.
